name: Witch King Valdris

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.description: A blast of necrotic energy that withers flesh and soul

abilities.name: Dark Ward
abilities.description: Summons shadowy tendrils that intercept incoming attacks

abilities.name: Command Undead
abilities.description: Issues an irresistible command to undead creatures within sight

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Siphons life force from a target to heal own wounds

appearance.eyes: hollow sockets with pinpoints of cold blue light
appearance.distinctive_features: Wears black robes embroidered with silver runes, skeletal hands, perpetual aura of cold mist

personality.demeanor: Speaks slowly and deliberately, treats mortals with contempt, radiates an air of ancient malevolence
personality.speaking_style: Archaic and formal, refers to himself in third person, pauses dramatically between sentences

beliefs: Death is merely a transition to true power
The living are resources to be harvested and used
Order and structure are necessary, even in darkness
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Remains calm and methodical. Relies on guards to handle physical threats while he casts from safety. Will use the Orb's power if truly threatened. Prefers to capture enemies for later use as undead servants rather than destroy them outright. Views combat as beneath him but will fight with ruthless efficiency when necessary.

visible: The Orb of Wonder (glowing with inner light)
Black robes with silver rune embroidery
hidden: Phylactery hidden in distant location (source of his undeath)

secrets: Is vulnerable to water - contact with blessed or running water disrupts his undead form
His phylactery is hidden in the catacombs beneath his childhood home
Fears true death and will abandon everything to preserve his existence
The Orb is slowly corrupting him, making him more unstable
backstory: Once a court wizard named Valdris, he was executed for forbidden necromantic experiments. He returned as a lich and spent centuries gathering power. Recently acquired the Orb of Wonder and plans to use it to extend his undead curse across the kingdom. Rules from his throne room with an iron fist, served by undead and fanatical cultists.
